company.description: Parallel Bio develops tools that help in the discovery and development of immunotherapies, to eliminate current barriers and create the fastest path to a drug that works. Parallel Bio's platform combines best-in-class human immune organoids with computational methods to generate unprecedented insights into human health and disease.
